info.name: Paint Store API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for Paint Store Management System.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set `base_url` (default: https://painter.rainbowstonerealestate.com/api/v1; local: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1)
3. Login sends OTP — run **Verify OTP - Customer** to save `customer_token`

## OTP Auth Flow
1. Register or Login → returns `session_id`
2. POST /auth/verify-otp with phone, otp, session_id, role
3. Dev mode (no TWOFACTOR_API_KEY): use OTP `123456`

## Single-vendor cart
- Cart may only contain products from **one vendor** (or platform products with no vendor)
- Adding from a different vendor → **409** `error: different_vendor`
- Use **Add to Cart (Replace Vendor)** with `"replace": true` to clear cart and switch vendor
- Checkout creates **one order** (not split by vendor)
- Test: add `product_id` 1 (vendor), then try `platform_product_id` 3 (platform) without replace

## Sample product IDs (after seed)
| ID | Product | Vendor |
|----|---------|--------|
| 1 | Royal Emulsion White | Sharma Paint Supplies |
| 3 | Wall Primer 10L | Paint Store (platform) |

## Roles
- **Customer** → POST /auth/login + verify-otp (role: customer)
- **Painter** → POST /auth/staff/login (role: painter) + verify-otp
- **Delivery** → POST /auth/staff/login (role: delivery_agent) + verify-otp
- **Vendor** → Website panel /vendor (email login)
- **Admin** → Website only at /admin

## Painter work flow
accept → start → before-images → after-images (or use /complete for both at once)

## Sample phones
| Role | Phone |
|------|-------|
| Customer | 9876543210 |
| Painter | 9876543211 |
| Delivery | 9876543212 |

item.name: Flow — Single Vendor Cart to Order
item.description:
Run these requests in order (Collection Runner):
1. **Auth → Login Customer** then **Verify OTP - Customer**
2. **Add to Cart** (product_id 1 — vendor)
3. **Add to Cart (Different Vendor — 409)** — confirms single-vendor rule
4. **Add to Cart (Replace Vendor)** — switch to platform product
5. **Checkout Preview** — verify vendor_label
6. **Place Order (Cash on Delivery)** or saved address variant
7. **Order History (By ID)** — track order

Clears cart and adds product from a different vendor. Set `replace: true` when user confirms switching stores.
